messages.text: Tell me about the Harlo B30 — price, hashrate, and when it ships.
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 miner

The Harlo B30 is $899. Around 30 TH/s on SHA-256, pulling roughly 360–450W, about 50 dB, WiFi or ethernet, power supply built in. Plug is matched to your address (US/UK/EU).

It's a pre-sale, not a ship-now item. Current batch is Batch 5, shipping November 30, 2026.

Want me to put one in your cart, or would you rather see something that ships this week?
